'''2009 Bespin Regionals Jared Hagen LS Massassi Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jared Hagen]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Massassi Base Operations / One In A Million|TA-L-massassibaseoperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' MB Oh No
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
